REF: 0061L: GAYFIELD PLACE LANE

 

Centrally located, 3-bedroom, (not HMO) main door house located on Gayfield Place Lane, at the top of Leith Walk and off Elm Row. Bus and tram links are readily available from the doorstep with services to the nearby City Centre as well as the West End, Leith and many other areas of Edinburgh. Princes Street is just a ten-minute walk and there are excellent local amenities on offer including shops, bars and restaurants just moments away.

 

The modern property is split over two levels with sloped ceilings on the upper level. It has neutral décor and is available UNFURNISHED with white goods, comprising:

~Bright and contemporary lounge with large window and laminate flooring

~Modernised kitchen, off-lounge, with appliances including dishwasher

~Tiled bathroom with electric shower over bath and three-piece suite

~Master double bedroom with built-in sliding mirrored wardrobes

~Second double bedroom with built-in wardrobes and carpeted flooring

~Further bedroom ideal as spare/guest room

~Stylish shower room with WC and wash hand basin

~Entrance hallway providing access to upper landing

~Zone parking (via council)

~Double glazing

~Gas heating

~Sorry, no pets

~Total floor area = 74m²

~Council tax: band E

~EPC rating: C

~Landlord registration: 53951/230/02020

~NO HMO LICENSE (not suitable for more than 2 unrelated single individuals)

~LARN1806025

 

Available: 28th August 2026

 

Rent: £1,725pcm

Deposit: £1,725

 

Please note the photographs shown within this advertisement may have been taken whilst a tenancy was active in the property and as a result you should not rely only on these as an accurate representation of furnishings and items included in the agreement. A full list of which items are included in the property is available upon request from our office, based on a previous tenancy. A viewing is therefore required in order to ensure you have an accurate understanding and knowledge of the condition and contents of the property.

 

Property Reference:

0061L EDI GPL
